cohort: 78 children with cerebral palsy (CP) and 60 healthy controls
finding: ApoE 2 and 4 alleles were more frequent in the patient group with cerebral palsy, while ApoE 3 allele was more frequent in the healthy controls.
mod_finding: In the patient group with apolipoprotein 4 or 2 alleles, the rate of emergency cesarean section was found being significantly higher than the group with 3 allele.
